units.source_text: “听说贵国认为一夫多妻是当然的事。

en.t: I hear that in your country polygamy is considered a matter of course.

units.source_text: 在一个家庭里有五个甚至十个妻子，关在阳光照射不到的闺房里，被当作男人的玩物，是吗？”

en.t: In a single household there are five or even ten wives, shut away in rooms where no sunlight reaches, and treated as men's playthings, is that right?
